description: React component for a modal dialog to confirm removal or keeping of a flagged message, including handling user comments and notifications.

methods.name: KeepRemoveFlaggedMessageConfirmationModal
methods.description: Main React functional component rendering the confirmation modal for flagged message actions.

methods.name: handleCommentChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the comment input, updates state, and validates if comment is required.

methods.name: handleToggleCommentPreview
methods.description: Toggles the preview mode for the comment textbox.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates the form, especially the comment if required, and sets error messages.

methods.name: handleConfirm
methods.description: Handles the confirmation action, calls appropriate API, manages loading state, and handles errors.
